text: As part of the proposal at 740 Dupont Street, a new traffic control signal is proposed to be installed at the site driveway connection to Dupont Street. The proposed traffic control signal will be located on Dupont Street, approximately 145 metres west of Christie Street. In support of this traffic signal control, the applicant has submitted detailed traffic signal, functional, and civil plans for the new intersection. These plans illustrate the required electrical and civil infrastructure work, along with pavement marking and signage for the new intersection and traffic control signal. The applicant will be responsible to fund and construct all of the related works shown on the plans to complete the full signalized intersection on Dupont Street. No further on-street parking or turning restrictions will be implemented on Dupont Street as part of this traffic signal control…

City Council on June 8 and 9, 2021, adopted the following: 1. City Council authorize the installation of traffic control signals at the intersection of Dupont Street and the private access located approximately 145 metres west of Christie Street.
